Done. I've implemented all three functions:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in src/num.js — returns n limited to the range [min, max] using early returns
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in src/util.js — formats byte counts as human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **`slugify(title)`** in src/text.js — converts titles to slugs by lowercasing, trimming, replacing space runs with dashes, and stripping non-alphanumeric characters
